# Liam Cornish

> Head of Technical Operations and Lead Product Designer, and a fully qualified electrical engineer with more than 25 years designing, building and commissioning renewable, off-grid and autonomous power systems for the world's harshest, highest-hazard environments. Designer of the internationally renowned Sunstone SICS, RAFT and ARC power platforms.

Liam is based in Whitstable, Kent, UK, and is open to senior or managerial engineering roles, UK-based or international, including hybrid working. Safety and efficiency underpin all of his design work, with a focus on operation and maintenance and on optimising multiple technologies into truly hybrid systems. Contact: 07845 619290, liamcornish79@gmail.com. Headline accreditations: MIET (Member of the IET), NEBOSH, City & Guilds 2391-52, 18th Edition BS 7671, NICEIC Solar PV Design & Installation, and CITB SMSTS.

## Key projects
- Sunstone SICS (Tengizchevroil / Chevron, with Fluor): 58 solar off-grid security systems delivered on time and on budget, contract value over £2.5M, commissioned with on-site training in the Tengiz oil field, Kazakhstan.
- Altnabreac Off-Grid Power Station (Telent / Network Rail / ScotRail): fully bespoke hybrid power station (9kW PV array, 12kW Bladon microturbine, 48kWh battery, Victron control), saving over £500k against a mains supply, with 100% uptime across more than two years off-grid.
- RAFT platforms (Tengizchevroil / Chevron): a new generation of 33 off-grid power platforms, contract value over £1M, proven from -40°C to over 50°C.
- ARC series (WJ Sunstone, originally a British MOD concept): the UK market-leading off-grid solar CCTV and communications platform, 400+ units deployed, with a recent HVO-optimised engine and Element Material Technologies certification.
